articles.title_en: Labor market institutions, productivity, and the business cycle: An application to Italy
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场制度、生产率与经济周期：以意大利为例的应用
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of labor market institutions on the cyclicality of labor productivity and aggregate fluctuations in Italy when two wage bargaining protocols (efficient Nash and right-to-manage) interact with three types of hiring costs. It uses a New Keynesian model with labor market frictions and labor effort estimated with Bayesian techniques using Italian quarterly data from 1996Q1 to 2018Q4. We find that technology shocks mainly explain labor productivity fluctuations. We focus on labor market deregulation by reducing real wage rigidity, hiring costs, and worker’s bargaining power. We show that, when labor effort varies, reforms trigger procyclical productivity under efficient bargaining, and countercyclical productivity under right-to-manage bargaining. Reforms have different effects on the volatility of labor market variables. We carry out several sensitivity analyses which confirm our results.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在两种工资谈判协议（有效纳什谈判和权利管理谈判）与三种招聘成本相互作用下，劳动力市场制度对意大利劳动生产率周期性和总体波动的影响。它使用了一个包含劳动力市场摩擦和劳动努力的新凯恩斯模型，并采用贝叶斯技术使用1996Q1至2018Q4的意大利季度数据进行估计。我们发现技术冲击主要解释了劳动生产率波动。我们通过降低实际工资刚性、招聘成本和工人的谈判能力来关注劳动力市场放松管制。我们表明，当劳动努力变化时，改革在有效谈判下引发顺周期的生产率，在权利管理谈判下引发逆周期的生产率。改革对劳动力市场变量的波动性有不同的影响。我们进行了多项敏感性分析，这些分析证实了我们的结果。

articles.title_cn: 通货膨胀与价格灵活性
articles.abstract_en: Using UK consumer price microdata, we report that aggregate price flexibility varies substantially over time and induces significant non-linearity in inflation. In a regime of high flexibility, the half-life of inflation drops by 50% and its volatility rises considerably. Such asymmetry arises naturally from state-dependent pricing, of which we find ample evidence in the data, particularly following the Great Recession. Neglecting this property may lead to a systematic underprediction of inflation, as seen in the post-pandemic inflation surge. Tracking real-time movements in price flexibility is crucial for assessing inflation dynamics and informing monetary policy decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用英国消费者价格微观数据，我们发现总体价格灵活性随时间显著变化，并导致通货膨胀出现显著的非线性。在高灵活性 regime 下，通货膨胀的半衰期下降 50%，其波动性显著上升。这种不对称性自然源于状态依赖定价，我们在数据中找到了充分证据，尤其是在大衰退之后。忽视这一特性可能导致对通货膨胀的系统性低估，正如疫情后通货膨胀激增所显示的那样。实时追踪价格灵活性的变动对于评估通货膨胀动态和指导货币政策决策至关重要。

articles.abstract_en: How does the rise of China affect innovation in other countries? I emphasize the importance of export competition, which means competition in third countries, in answering this question for two reasons. First, since Chinese exports have grown worldwide, firms in other countries compete against China not only in their domestic market but also in their export markets. Second, since innovation is skewed toward exporters, competition in export markets could have innovation consequences. Exploiting South Korean patent data using a novel firm-level measure of export competition, I find that (i) export competition with China increases Korean firms’ innovation, (ii) this response is driven particularly by high-productivity firms, and (iii) increased innovation is associated with product quality improvement. These findings are rationalized by a multi-country model of endogenous innovation incorporating consumers with quality preferences and firms with heterogeneous productivity.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国的崛起如何影响其他国家的创新？在回答这个问题时，我强调出口竞争（即第三国的竞争）的重要性，原因有两个。首先，由于中国的出口在全球范围内增长，其他国家的企业不仅在国内市场上与中国竞争，而且在出口市场上与中国竞争。其次，由于创新偏向于出口商，出口市场的竞争可能会产生创新后果。利用韩国专利数据，采用一种新颖的企业层面出口竞争衡量标准，我发现（i）与中国的出口竞争增加了韩国企业的创新，（ii）这种反应尤其是由高生产率企业推动的，（iii）创新的增加与产品质量的提高相关。这些发现通过内生创新的多国模型合理化，该模型将具有质量偏好的消费者和具有异质生产力的企业结合起来。

articles.title_en: Dynamic effects of labor income taxation in an unequal Schumpeterian economy
articles.title_cn: 不平等熊彼特经济中劳动所得税的动态影响
articles.abstract_en: How does taxation affect growth and inequality? To study this question, we develop a Schumpeterian model in which wealth heterogeneity influences the effects of tax policy. The key mechanism is that a change in consumption dispersion across heterogeneous households due to a change in labor income taxation can cause a novel positive effect on the employment of poor households in addition to the usual negative effect on the employment of rich households. Together, these effects yield an overall ambiguous response of employment to labor income taxation. A negative (positive) change of employment causes a negative (positive) change of innovation-driven growth in the short run and also a negative (positive) change of the real interest rate. Consequently, labor income taxation has an ambiguous effect on income inequality (e.g., asset income falls while labor income may rise) but unambiguously increases consumption inequality by reducing disposable wage income even for households that work more. Therefore, the effects on income inequality and consumption inequality are drastically different. We calibrate the model to examine its quantitative implications.
articles.abstract_cn: 税收如何影响增长和不平等？为了研究这个问题，我们开发了一个熊彼特模型，其中财富异质性影响税收政策的效果。其关键机制在于，劳动所得税制变化导致的异质家庭消费离散度的变化，除了对富裕家庭就业产生通常的负面影响外，还会对贫困家庭就业产生新的积极影响。这些影响共同导致了就业对劳动所得税的整体模糊反应。就业的负（正）变化会导致短期内创新驱动增长的负（正）变化，也会导致实际利率负（正）变化。因此，劳动所得税对收入不平等的影响不明确（例如，资产收入下降，而劳动收入可能上升），但通过减少可支配工资收入，即使对于工作较多的家庭来说，也明确增加了消费不平等。因此，对收入不平等和消费不平等的影响截然不同。我们校准模型以检查其定量影响。

articles.title_en: Capital-skill complementarity in manufacturing: Lessons from the US shale boom
articles.title_cn: 制造业中的资本-技能互补性：来自美国页岩气繁荣的启示
articles.abstract_en: This paper tests the existence of capital-skill complementarity in the manufacturing sector using quasi-experimental increases in the relative price of low-skill labor induced by the US shale boom. I find that in response to the shale boom, local manufacturing firms decreased their relative usage of low-skill labor while increasing their capital expenditures. These endogenous changes in the input mix allowed manufacturers to maintain the value added despite the increase in the price of low-skill labor, avoiding the potential short-term crowding-out effects of the natural resource boom. These findings perfectly match the predictions from a nested CES manufacturing production function where capital and low-skill labor are nested together, and their elasticity of substitution exceeds that between capital and high-skill labor. Alternative production functions yield predictions that are inconsistent with the data or hard to reconcile with the previous literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用美国页岩气繁荣引起的低技能劳动力相对价格准实验性上升，检验了制造业中资本-技能互补性的存在。我发现，面对页岩气繁荣，当地制造业企业减少了低技能劳动力的相对使用，同时增加了资本支出。这些投入组合的内生变化使得制造商能够在低技能劳动力价格上涨的情况下维持增加值，避免了自然资源繁荣可能带来的短期挤出效应。这些发现与嵌套CES制造业生产函数的预测完全吻合，其中资本和低技能劳动力嵌套在一起，且它们的替代弹性超过了资本与高技能劳动力之间的替代弹性。其他生产函数得出的预测与数据不一致或难以与先前文献相协调。

articles.title_en: Anchored inflation expectations and the slope of the Phillips curve
articles.title_cn: 锚定通胀预期和菲利普斯曲线的斜率
articles.abstract_en: It is conventional wisdom that the reduced form Phillips curve has become flatter in recent decades. Accordingly, we show that the statistical relationship between changes in U.S. inflation and economic activity, commonly known as the accelerationist Phillips curve, has become flatter. But in contrast, the statistical relationship between the level of inflation and economic activity, which we refer to as the “original” Phillips curve, has become steeper. By allowing for changes in the degree of anchoring of agents’ inflation forecasts, we recover a stable structural slope parameter in an estimated version of the New Keynesian Phillips curve (NKPC) from 1960 to 2019. Using a New Keynesian model with imperfect information, we show that imperfectly anchored inflation expectations, coupled with an inflation-targeting central bank, induce an upward bias in the slope of the accelerationist Phillips curve but a downward bias in the slope of the original Phillips curve relative to the true structural slope of the NKPC. Improved anchoring shrinks both biases, accounting for the observed changes in the slopes of the reduced form Phillips curve relationships.
articles.abstract_cn: 传统观点认为近几十年来简化的菲利普斯曲线变得更加平坦。因此，我们表明，美国通胀变化与经济活动之间的统计关系（通常称为加速菲利普斯曲线）已经变得更加平坦。但相比之下，通货膨胀水平与经济活动之间的统计关系，即我们所说的“原始”菲利普斯曲线，变得更加陡峭。通过允许代理人通胀预测锚定程度的变化，我们在新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线（NKPC）的估计版本中从1960到2019恢复了稳定的结构斜率参数。使用不完全信息的新凯恩斯主义模型，我们表明，不完全锚定的通胀预期，加上通胀目标制央行，导致加速主义菲利普斯曲线的斜率相对于NKPC的真实结构斜率出现向上偏差，但原始菲利普斯曲线的斜率出现向下偏差。改进的锚定缩小了两种偏差，解释了观察到的简化形式菲利普斯曲线关系的斜率变化。

articles.title_cn: 我们需要一个（大型）委员会吗？
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies committee design when a homogeneous population is uncertain about which alternative is correct, individuals can acquire costly information about the state of the world, and the decision must be taken via voting with the majority rule. We assume verifiability of costs and cost sharing, which are realistic assumptions in many applications, e.g. if the time spent in learning is recorded, or if reports have to be produced. We show that the optimal committee size depends on the properties of the cost function and on the size of the population. If either the marginal cost function satisfies a standard single-crossing condition or the population is sufficiently large, it is optimal to delegate voting to a small committee and often to a single individual, in which case no committee is needed at all. If information acquisition costs increase slowly for small values of information, but the magnitude of such costs is large, the optimal committee might comprise many members. Our results add a rationale for the widespread use of small committees for decision-making.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了当同质群体对哪个选项正确存在不确定性、个体可以获取关于世界状态的有成本信息、且决策必须通过多数规则投票作出时的委员会设计问题。我们假设成本的可验证性和成本分摊，这在许多应用中都是现实的假设，例如，如果学习所花费的时间被记录，或者如果需要提交报告。我们表明，最优委员会规模取决于成本函数的性质和群体规模。如果边际成本函数满足标准的单交叉条件，或者群体足够大，那么将投票委托给一个小型委员会通常是最优的，且往往委托给单个个体，在这种情况下根本不需要委员会。如果信息获取成本对于小量信息增长缓慢，但此类成本的量级较大，则最优委员会可能包含许多成员。我们的结果为决策中广泛使用小型委员会提供了理论依据。

articles.title_en: Intelligence and strategy choice in indefinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemma games: A replication of Proto, Rustichini & Sofianos (2022)
articles.title_cn: 无限重复囚徒困境博弈中的智力与策略选择：对Proto、Rustichini与Sofianos（2022）的复制研究
articles.abstract_en: We provide a close replication of the original study of Proto et al. (2022) which examines the link between intelligence, strategy choice and errors in strategy implementation in indefinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemma games. Our experiments, powered at 99% to detect the effect sizes obtained in the original study, replicate all the findings of the original study: (1) cooperation rates in the first period of an indefinitely repeated game are not found to be correlated with intelligence; (2) subjects with a higher level of intelligence are more likely to be conditionally cooperative; (3) more intelligent subjects make fewer errors when implementing their strategy. Our experiments validate the results of the original study, and lend credence to its findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们对Proto等人（2022）的原始研究进行了紧密复制，该研究考察了无限重复囚徒困境博弈中智力、策略选择与策略实施错误之间的联系。我们的实验以99%的统计功效检测原始研究中获得的效应量，复制了原始研究的所有发现：（1）无限重复博弈第一阶段的合作率与智力无关；（2）智力水平较高的被试更可能采取条件合作策略；（3）智力较高的被试在实施策略时犯的错误更少。我们的实验验证了原始研究的结果，并为其发现提供了支持。

articles.title_en: Measuring top wealth shares in the UK
articles.title_cn: 衡量英国顶层财富份额
articles.abstract_en: We examine how the measurement of aggregate wealth affects our understanding of wealth distribution. We explain why choices over wealth aggregates can affect the measured level and composition of wealth concentration. Applying this to the UK, we find estimates of the top 1% wealth share vary by 2.1pp – between 14.4% and 16.5% – in 2016–18, depending on the choices we make regarding aggregates and the source of distributional information. Alternative definitions for aggregates lead to a reranking of who is at the top, replacing 40% of individuals in the top 1%, and changing the share of women and older individuals. We discuss conceptual and measurement issues with the National Accounts as a source of wealth aggregates, and argue that in many cases they are poorly aligned in both regards with the measure of personal wealth one would like to target, and in practice are less comparable internationally than they initially seem. In the UK, where the wealth survey has reasonably good coverage across the distribution, we therefore prefer survey aggregates.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了总财富的衡量方式如何影响我们对财富分配的理解。我们解释了为何对财富总量的选择会影响所测得的财富集中程度及其构成。将此应用于英国，我们发现，根据我们在总量和分配信息来源方面的不同选择，顶层1%财富份额的估计值在2-14.4%年间介于16.5%和2016之间，相差18个百分点。对总量的不同定义会导致顶层人群的重新排序，替换掉顶层40%中1%的个人，并改变女性和年长个体的占比。我们讨论了将国民账户作为财富总量来源时存在的概念和衡量问题，并认为在许多情况下，国民账户在这两方面都与人们希望针对的个人财富衡量标准契合度不高，且实际上其国际可比性并不像初看时那样强。在英国，由于财富调查在分配上的覆盖相当良好，我们因此更倾向于使用调查总量数据。
